column2: [intro]
In my room, it's a real mess,
Trinkets everywhere, it's a total distress.
Plastic ducks up to the ceiling high,
Stuffed cacti dancing, oh my, oh my.
I gather all that I adore,
A collection that’s crazy and more.
Quirky objects with no real worth,
But I’m proud, it’s my sense of mirth.
Cowboy hats and maracas too,
Seashells from the Bahamas' view.
Old gadgets that no longer buzz,
But I keep them close, they’re my special fuss.
I gather all that I adore,
A collection that’s crazy and more.
Quirky objects with no real worth,
But I’m proud, it’s my sense of mirth.
[ solo ]
So come, come into my wild domain,
Where every object brings a smile, not pain.
Life’s too short not to have fun,
With my collection, joy’s never done.
[outro]
